messages:
jordan_sales: Hi team — GovTech asking for an EU-only POC. They require BYO-KMS (customer-managed keys in EU), and want to confirm we can prevent any data leaving EU. Also need pricing for dedicated reserved capacity vs hosted with routing pin. They ask what happens if EU capacity is exhausted — reject or failover to US? Need answers by EOD.

nina_presales: Short answer: we support both strict EU-only and preferred-EU policies. Strict = requests fail with 429/error if no EU capacity; Preferred = will failover to allowed fallback region (e.g., US). BYO-KMS is supported for hosted/dedicated but keys must be accessible from the region. See: https://redwood.example/docs/routing-policies :link:

kai_network: @nina_presales +1. Technical notes: BYO-KMS requires network path to customer's KMS endpoint in EU (or an EU KMS provider). If the KMS is in AWS eu-west-1, routing must keep control-plane crypto operations in eu-west-1. If you want strict, configure `routing: strict` and `kms_binding: regional`.
Example config (pseudocode): `routing_policy: { mode: "strict", regions: ["eu-west-1"], kms_binding: "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/xxx" }`

oliver_sec: From security side: we can do EU-only processing but need customer's KMS ARN and an executed addendum for BYO-KMS. Subprocessor inventory: Google Cloud (europe zones), Cloudflare, and our telemetry vendor — we'll provide the certs/attestations. Also need SCAR/PCM answers for their security questionnaire (email me their doc).

emily_support: What's the target QPS / concurrent sessions for POC? We need expected RPS + average prompt length to size dedicated capacity and give a price estimate.

jordan_sales: They're aiming for 50 qps peak, 10 qps sustained, sequences ~512 tokens, approx 200k tokens/day. POC duration 6 weeks. They want 99.9% uptime SLA for the POC. What's the price delta and lead time to provision dedicated pools in EU?

nina_presales: Ballpark: dedicated reserved pool (EU-only) will have a provisioning lead of ~7 business days, and pricing is typically a fixed monthly capacity fee + usage. For a POC of this size expect a modest commit — I'll put together a quote. Cost delta vs hosted depends on commit term; rough rule: dedicated commit trades some per-token cost improvement for a fixed hourly reserve. BYO-KMS can add a flat egress/ops fee and a one-time onboarding charge.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #POC-9821 — POC sizing + KMS onboarding assigned to eng-presales. ETA for initial quote: 24h.

oliver_sec: Also note: if they insist on strict mode, ensure the SLA/contract reflects that we will return errors rather than failover. That has implications for availability targets — ops needs to be aware.

jordan_sales: Thanks — next steps: (1) @nina_presales assemble draft quote and list of contract changes for strict routing, (2) @kai_network confirm KMS network checks and provide quick validation steps we can run with customer, (3) @oliver_sec send subproc inventory and sample attestation, (4) @emily_support prepare provisioning timeline. I'll loop in customer legal and ops. :raised_hands:

nina_presales: On it. Will share quote + config snippet in this thread within 24h.
